A '''guard''' was a jailkeeper in the [[prison]] on the [[asteroid]] [[Borgo Prime]], working for a [[Silvo's pirates|pirate crew]] under the command of [[Captain]] [[Brutus]]. The individual was a [[humanoid]] dressed in a rugged and heavily armored [[Clothing|outfit]], including a face-concealing [[helmet]], and equipped with an [[electro-shock prod]], which they utilized for disciplining inmates.<ref name="SC 103" /> 

Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="SCDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> the guard electrocuted a [[Unidentified electrocuted prisoner|Talpiddian inmate]], which made it possible for the fugitive [[Jod Na Nawood]] to lead the [[Skeleton Crew]] [[youngling]]s across the hallway, facilitating their escape.<ref name="SC 103" /> However, [[KB]] had not made it across the corridor, and found<ref name="SC 103" /> herself<ref name="SC 101 AD">{{SkeletonCrew|This Could Be a Real Adventure}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> unable to join the others.<ref name="SC 103" /> Given the guard had finished electrocuting the [[Talpiddian]], Jod used [[the Force]] to distract them and their [[Unidentified guard (Borgo Prime)|colleague]], clearing the way for KB to sneak across without being noticed.<ref name="SC 103" />

==Behind the scenes==
The individual first appeared in "[[Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem]]," the third episode of the [[Disney+]] live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'',<ref name="SC 103" /> which was aired on [[December 10]], [[2024]].<ref name="Premiere">{{Twitter|StarWars|status/1861409832349172011|[[Star Wars]]|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/QwMYe}}</ref>
